boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Free, self-guided maritime-history stops at SUNY Maritime’s Maritime Industry Museum in Fort Schuyler.

cards.title: Trace The Evolution of Seafaring
cards.subtitle: Maritime Industry Museum, Fort Schuyler
cards.notes: Start in the second-floor main exhibit and move chronologically from sailing-era material toward modern shipping displays.
cards.short_summary: A chronological self-guided museum walk through seafaring history.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Maritime identifies “The Evolution of Seafaring” as the museum’s second-floor main exhibit and states that admission is free.
cards.access_notes: Museum hours are Monday–Saturday, 9 AM–4 PM; SUNY Maritime states admission and parking are free.

cards.title: Compare Early Sailing Vessel Models
cards.subtitle: Maritime Industry Museum, Fort Schuyler
cards.notes: Use the main exhibit’s early-vessel models to compare hull shapes and rigging details with a friend at an unhurried pace.
cards.short_summary: A close-looking activity centered on historic sailing-vessel models.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Maritime lists models of early sailing vessels within its main exhibit and states that museum admission is free.
cards.access_notes: Museum hours are Monday–Saturday, 9 AM–4 PM; SUNY Maritime states admission and parking are free.

cards.title: Spot the Clipper Ship Models
cards.subtitle: Maritime Industry Museum, Fort Schuyler
cards.notes: Find the clipper-ship models in the chronological exhibit, then pick out details that distinguish them from the earlier vessels.
cards.short_summary: A no-cost model hunt inside the museum’s main exhibit.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Maritime says the museum’s main exhibit includes models of clipper ships and that admission is free.
cards.access_notes: Museum hours are Monday–Saturday, 9 AM–4 PM; SUNY Maritime states admission and parking are free.

cards.title: Look Over Turn-of-the-Century Vessels
cards.subtitle: Maritime Industry Museum, Fort Schuyler
cards.notes: Pause at the turn-of-the-century vessel models and use the nearby sequence of displays to place them in the museum’s timeline.
cards.short_summary: A museum stop focused on vessels from the turn of the twentieth century.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Maritime says the main exhibit includes models of turn-of-the-century vessels and that admission is free.
cards.access_notes: Museum hours are Monday–Saturday, 9 AM–4 PM; SUNY Maritime states admission and parking are free.

cards.title: Inspect Navigational Instruments
cards.subtitle: Maritime Industry Museum, Fort Schuyler
cards.notes: Make this a detail-oriented stop: examine the historic and modern navigational instruments named in the museum’s main exhibit.
cards.short_summary: A free, focused look at maritime navigation tools.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Maritime says the main exhibit includes navigational instruments from bygone days to modern times and that admission is free.
cards.access_notes: Museum hours are Monday–Saturday, 9 AM–4 PM; SUNY Maritime states admission and parking are free.

cards.title: Walk Through Modern Shipping
cards.subtitle: A-Deck, North Wing, Maritime Industry Museum
cards.notes: Visit the A-Deck North Wing display and compare the specialized container ships and crude-oil tankers described on the tour.
cards.short_summary: A self-guided look at contemporary specialized shipping vessels.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Maritime’s museum walking tour names the “Modern Shipping” exhibit and describes container ships and crude-oil tankers; admission is free.
cards.access_notes: Museum hours are Monday–Saturday, 9 AM–4 PM; SUNY Maritime states admission and parking are free.

cards.title: Study Shipbuilding and Military Seafaring
cards.subtitle: A-Deck, North Wing, Maritime Industry Museum
cards.notes: Use the Brooklyn Navy Yard model as a starting point, then discuss how the exhibit connects construction with military seafaring.
cards.short_summary: A free exhibit stop anchored by a Brooklyn Navy Yard model.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Maritime’s museum walking tour names the “Shipbuilding and Military Seafaring” exhibit and its Brooklyn Navy Yard model; admission is free.
cards.access_notes: Museum hours are Monday–Saturday, 9 AM–4 PM; SUNY Maritime states admission and parking are free.

cards.title: Browse the Model Gallery
cards.subtitle: B-Deck, North Wing, Maritime Industry Museum
cards.notes: Head to B-Deck North Wing to view the gallery’s large-scale ocean-liner models and compare their distinctive silhouettes.
cards.short_summary: A free gallery visit for maritime model fans.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Maritime’s museum walking tour identifies the Model Gallery on B-Deck North Wing; SUNY Maritime states museum admission is free.
cards.access_notes: Museum hours are Monday–Saturday, 9 AM–4 PM; SUNY Maritime states admission and parking are free.

cards.title: Find the S.S. Bremen Model
cards.subtitle: Model Gallery, Maritime Industry Museum
cards.notes: In the Model Gallery, look for the large-scale S.S. Bremen model listed on the museum walking tour and examine it closely.
cards.short_summary: A named ocean-liner model to seek out during a free museum visit.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Maritime’s museum walking tour lists a large-scale model of the S.S. Bremen in the Model Gallery; admission is free.
cards.access_notes: Museum hours are Monday–Saturday, 9 AM–4 PM; SUNY Maritime states admission and parking are free.

cards.title: Stroll The Promenade Exhibit
cards.subtitle: B-Deck, North Wing, Maritime Industry Museum
cards.notes: Walk the Promenade exhibit with a friend and look for the shipping-line material connected to North American superliners.
cards.short_summary: A free museum walk through an exhibit on passenger-ship travel.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Maritime’s museum walking tour names “The Promenade” exhibit and says it covers North American superliners; admission is free.
cards.access_notes: Museum hours are Monday–Saturday, 9 AM–4 PM; SUNY Maritime states admission and parking are free.
